description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.

latest_release.name: v1.7.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(models): frontier model check matches the model name only, never the provider route by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1280
* feat(reporting): link HTTP exchange evidence by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1281
* feat(prompts): require http_exchange_ids for proxy-validated findings by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1292
* docs: add Vercel AI Gateway provider guide by @erulkey in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1254
* fix(web_search): send only the agent's query to Exa search by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1306
* chore(deps): require litellm>=1.101.0 so gpt-6-astra accepts max_tokens by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1318
* feat(config): STRIX_API_TYPE forces responses vs chat completions by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1324
* fix(build): keep the TUI sidecar hook importable on hatchling 1.32.1 by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1325
* fix(runtime): place extra files as agent-writable sandbox files on every backend by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1330
* Prompt agents to include local Git blame in technical details by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1329
* fix(reporting): reduce git blame guidance to a trailing hint on the reporting tool by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1336
* runtime: read_only local sources become :ro bind mounts by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1342
* feat(mcp): initialize connections lazily by @yoni-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1347
* feat(llm): structured per-attempt provider request log with provider request ids by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1353
* Let agents delete a vulnerability report they filed by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1354
* Fill in blank tool-call ids so strict providers accept the history by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1355
* fix(dev): make check-all non-mutating by @Czech-Knight in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1360
* fix(tui): suspend on ctrl+z by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1371
* docs(skills): refresh framework behavior and security testing guidance by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1372
* perf(prompt): put per-run scope at the end of the system prompt by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1375
* perf(llm): give Claude a cache point before the per-run scope by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1376
* perf(prompt): load requested skills after a cache point by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1382
* feat(tui): animate the wait_for_agents indicator by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1383
* feat(budget): budget_policy=pause — park every agent at the cost limit until the operator resumes by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1387
* perf(llm): pin OpenRouter agents to one provider with session IDs by @ian-at-strix in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1386
* chore(models): remove the model quality warning and its allowlists by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1388
* fix(reporting): restore create_vulnerability_report parameter descrip… by @bearsyankees in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1391
* fix(config): choose Responses vs chat completions from the model, not the base URL by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1407
* fix(config): use the Responses API whenever the model supports it by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1408
* fix(finish_scan): stop asking for a section heading in every report field by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1411
* fix(tui): link every wrapped line of the viewer URL to the full URL by @0xallam in https://github.com/usestrix/strix/pull/1412
* feat(cli): Add --

# Strix ### The open-source AI pentesting tool. Autonomous AI hackers that find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
[![](https://dcbadge.limes.pink/api/server/strix-ai)](https://discord.gg/strix-ai)
> [!TIP] > **New!** Strix integrates seamlessly with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.
